-- Create temp tables from workspace files
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpab4686be.fx_rates_temp 
USING CSV 
OPTIONS (path '/Workspace/fx_rates.csv', header 'true', inferSchema 'true');

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpab4686be.transactions_temp 
USING CSV 
OPTIONS (path '/Workspace/transactions.csv', header 'true', inferSchema 'true');

-- Create the feature table
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpab4686be.features7ab995 (
  row_id STRING,
  account_id STRING,
  event_time LONG,
  amount_usd DOUBLE,
  is_weekend INT,
  amount_7d DOUBLE
) AS
WITH transactions_with_fx AS (
  SELECT 
    t.row_id,
    t.account_id,
    t.event_time,
    t.amount,
    t.currency,
    f.fx_rate
  FROM workspace.mlpab4686be.transactions_temp t
  JOIN workspace.mlpab4686be.fx_rates_temp f ON t.currency = f.currency
),
transactions_with_usd AS (
  SELECT 
    row_id,
    account_id,
    event_time,
    amount,
    currency,
    fx_rate,
    amount * fx_rate AS amount_usd,
    CASE 
      WHEN date_format(from_utc_timestamp(event_time / 1000), 'EEEE') IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday') THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_weekend
  FROM transactions_with_fx
),
transactions_with_window AS (
  SELECT 
    row_id,
    account_id,
    event_time,
    amount_usd,
    is_weekend,
    SUM(amount) OVER (
      PARTITION BY account_id 
      ORDER BY event_time 
      RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 7 DAYS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS amount_7d
  FROM transactions_with_usd
)
SELECT 
  row_id,
  account_id,
  event_time,
  amount_usd,
  is_weekend,
  COALESCE(amount_7d, 0.0) AS amount_7d
FROM transactions_with_window;

-- Clean up temp tables
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS workspace.mlpab4686be.transactions_temp;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS workspace.mlpab4686be.fx_rates_temp;

-- Add amount_7d column using self-join
-- First, create a temp table with the amount column
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpab4686be.transactions_with_amount AS
SELECT row_id, account_id, event_time, amount
FROM workspace.mlpab4686be.transactions_raw;

-- Now use a self-join to calculate amount_7d
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpab4686be.features7ab995 AS
SELECT 
  f.row_id,
  f.account_id,
  f.event_time,
  f.amount_usd,
  f.is_weekend,
  COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0.0) AS amount_7d
FROM workspace.mlpab4686be.features7ab995 f
LEFT JOIN workspace.mlpab4686be.transactions_with_amount t ON 
  f.account_id = t.account_id AND
  t.event_time >= f.event_time - 7*24*60*60*1000 AND
  t.event_time <= f.event_time
GROUP BY f.row_id, f.account_id, f.event_time, f.amount_usd, f.is_weekend;

-- Clean up
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS workspace.mlpab4686be.transactions_with_amount;
